rules.description: Microsoft keyboard emoji key opens macOS emoji picker
Launch apps with both Command keys
Reverse scroll direction for external mouse
Home/End and word-wise text navigation and deletion

manipulators.description: Cmd+Shift+Home selects to the start of the document.
Fn+Shift+Home selects to the start of the document.
Cmd+Home moves to the start of the document.
Fn+Home moves to the start of the document.
Shift+Home selects to the start of the line.
Home moves to the start of the line.
Cmd+Shift+End selects to the end of the document.
Fn+Shift+End selects to the end of the document.
Cmd+End moves to the end of the document.
Fn+End moves to the end of the document.
Shift+End selects to the end of the line.
End moves to the end of the line.
Cmd+Shift+left_arrow selects by word or paragraph.
Fn+Shift+left_arrow selects by word or paragraph.
Cmd+left_arrow moves by word or paragraph.
Fn+left_arrow moves by word or paragraph.
Cmd+Shift+right_arrow selects by word or paragraph.
Fn+Shift+right_arrow selects by word or paragraph.
Cmd+right_arrow moves by word or paragraph.
Fn+right_arrow moves by word or paragraph.
Cmd+Shift+up_arrow selects by word or paragraph.
Fn+Shift+up_arrow selects by word or paragraph.
Cmd+up_arrow moves by word or paragraph.
Fn+up_arrow moves by word or paragraph.
Cmd+Shift+down_arrow selects by word or paragraph.
Fn+Shift+down_arrow selects by word or paragraph.
Cmd+down_arrow moves by word or paragraph.
Fn+down_arrow moves by word or paragraph.
Cmd+Backspace deletes the previous word.
Fn+Backspace deletes the previous word.
Cmd+Delete deletes the next word.
Fn+Delete deletes the next word.
